lead.headline: BNY Mellon MiCA registration signals bank custody race is accelerating
lead.tldr: Traditional financial infrastructure is hardening around regulated crypto rails, while DeFi incumbents consolidate and distressed token projects face restructuring. The gap between compliant and non-compliant infrastructure is widening into a moat.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks how regulatory scaffolding and institutional balance-sheet decisions are rapidly repricing what 'infrastructure' means in Web3.

top_signals.title: Strategy Raises $544.5M and Buys Back STRC Shares
top_signals.summary: MicroStrategy has increased its US dollar reserves to $3.75 billion by raising $544.5 million through stock sales. The company also executed a $25 million buyback of STRC shares.
top_signals.why_it_matters: MicroStrategy's $544.5M raise and $25M STRC buyback signal that Saylor views the equity itself as undervalued relative to its embedded Bitcoin optionality, not merely a fundraising vehicle.

top_signals.title: Lido begins consolidating $16 billion worth of staked ETH as Curated Module v2 rolls out
top_signals.summary: Lido is consolidating over 8 million ETH (approximately $16 billion) onto larger validators in preparation for the Ethereum Pectra upgrade. This move is part of the rollout of Curated Module v2 to optimize validator efficiency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Lido's $16B validator consolidation ahead of Pectra is a forced efficiency play that concentrates staking risk into fewer operators, making the 'decentralized' liquid staking thesis harder to underwrite.

top_signals.title: STORJ token falls 20% as decentralized storage firm files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy amid crypto shutdown wave
top_signals.summary: Storj Labs has filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy to address legacy liabilities. Following the announcement, the STORJ token experienced a price drop of approximately 20%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Storj's Chapter 11 filing and 20% token collapse demonstrate that token-model liabilities can outlast product-market fit, creating a template for how distressed crypto infrastructure gets repriced through bankruptcy.

top_signals.title: BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providers43m, BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providersBNY Mellon’s European subsidiary joined the MiCA register as ESMA added 15 CASPs, including banks and crypto platforms, in the third post-deadline update.
top_signals.summary: BNY Mellon's European subsidiary has officially joined the MiCA register. The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) added 15 Crypto-Asset Service Providers (CASPs), including major banks and crypto platforms, in its latest update.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BNY Mellon's MiCA registration alongside 14 other CASPs marks the point where bank custody becomes a regulated commodity rather than a competitive differentiator, shifting value to execution and integration.

top_signals.title: South Korea's KB Kookmin Bank to launch cross-border payment service on JPMorgan's Kinexys: report
top_signals.summary: South Korea's largest bank, KB Kookmin Bank, is set to launch a blockchain-based cross-border corporate payment service. The service will utilize JPMorgan's Kinexys platform to streamline international transactions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: KB Kookmin's Kinexys integration shows JPMorgan's blockchain payment rails are becoming the default plumbing for Asian bank-correspondent relationships, sidelapping public-chain alternatives.

deals.summary: MicroStrategy has increased its US dollar reserves to $3.75 billion by raising $544.5 million through stock sales. The company also executed a $25 million buyback of STRC shares.
Payward, the parent company of Kraken, has acquired the wallet business from Magic Labs. This move aims to enhance Kraken's self-custody and onboarding capabilities for users.

Circle has acquired IBM's extensive blockchain patent portfolio, consisting of over 680 patent families and nearly 1,000 issued patents. This acquisition positions Circle as the largest holder of blockchain patents in the United States.
ETN has raised $1.6 million from Powerhouse Capital and Axel Springer to support its goal of becoming Europe's TBPN. The funding comes ahead of a planned relaunch of the project.

on_the_radar.title: Triple-A confirms treasury-wallet breach after losses reach $11.8M 43m, Triple-A confirms treasury-wallet breach after losses reach $11.8M The stablecoin payments company said client funds were unaffected and that the financial impact would be absorbed through its treasury reserves.
on_the_radar.summary: Stablecoin payments provider Triple-A confirmed a security breach of its treasury wallet resulting in a loss of $11.8 million. The company stated that client funds remain safe and the loss will be covered by its own treasury reserves.

on_the_radar.title: The Funding: Are crypto vaults funds and curators fund managers?
on_the_radar.summary: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce suggests that crypto vaults and their curators may be classified as fund managers. This classification could mandate registration with regulatory bodies, potentially increasing the compliance burden for DeFi protocols.

on_the_radar.title: BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcement15m, BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcementUsers reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.
on_the_radar.summary: BitMart is experiencing reported withdrawal delays and freezes following a wind-down announcement. This has coincided with a significant drop in wallet balances and a sharp decline in the value of its BMX token.

on_the_radar.title: Hong Kong Prepares Banks for Quantum Threats
on_the_radar.summary: Hong Kong has introduced a quantum-readiness index to help banks prepare for potential quantum computing threats. This initiative coincides with the expansion of tokenized deposits, digital-asset custody, and blockchain settlement systems within the region.

on_the_radar.title: Securitize Registers as SEC Investment Adviser Through Capital Unit
on_the_radar.summary: Securitize Capital has officially registered as an investment adviser with the SEC. This move allows the firm to expand its regulated platform for institutional clients and further its growth in onchain capital markets.

on_the_radar.title: Binance disappears from Google Play in certain EU countries3m, Binance disappears from Google Play in certain EU countriesBinance’s Android app is unavailable on Google Play in some EU markets amid scrutiny over MiCA compliance.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance's Android application has been removed from the Google Play Store in several European Union markets. The move is linked to ongoing scrutiny regarding the exchange's compliance with the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation.

on_the_radar.title: Brazil Police Bust Cartel Laundering Billions With Crypto
on_the_radar.summary: Brazilian police have dismantled a drug cartel that allegedly laundered billions of reals using cryptocurrencies, shell companies, and luxury assets. The operation highlights the use of digital assets for large-scale illicit financial activities.

on_the_radar.title: Zimbabwe Adds Seven Fintech Projects to Regulatory Sandbox
on_the_radar.summary: Zimbabwe's securities regulator has admitted seven fintech projects into its regulatory sandbox. Four of these projects are specifically focused on the tokenization of assets, securities, or infrastructure.

worth_a_read.note: Nothing's 100-job cut is worth tracking as a proxy for how Web3-adjacent hardware and consumer plays are faring in the broader tech contraction.

linkedin_post:
Three balance-sheet moves today, none of them about retail. MicroStrategy raised $544.5 million and immediately bought back $25 million of its own STRC shares. That is not a company starved for Bitcoin acquisition firepower. That is a company that thinks its equity is cheap relative to the asset it holds. We underwrite that differently.

Then BNY Mellon's European unit registered under MiCA, one of fifteen CASPs ESMA approved in its third post-deadline batch. The register is becoming crowded. Custody is not a moat anymore; it is table stakes. What gets repriced next is who can plug that custody into corporate treasury workflows without friction. KB Kookmin choosing JPMorgan's Kinexys for cross-border payments, not a public chain, is one answer.

Against this, Storj filed Chapter 11. Token down 20%. The model where protocol tokens fund operations and also trade on secondary markets is being stress-tested in bankruptcy court. What equity, if any, converts to what claims, will set a marker.

Lido's $16 billion validator consolidation is the other side: efficiency at the cost of operator concentration. We are watching whether stakers vote with their feet, or whether liquidity inertia keeps capital parked.

The test for our thesis: does the next MiCA batch include a US bank of comparable size to BNY Mellon, or does regulatory arbitrage keep them offshore?
